tagline: Offline optical data exchange · screen → camera
summary: G1 is approved. Single-QR + Fountain achieved a verified 1 MiB SHA-256 PASS at 2.40 KB/s; native 4QR + Fountain improved to 3.62 KB/s but scaled only ~1.51× despite 4× displayed QR capacity. TF-003 is closed and the performance path has pivoted to TF-004 OptiGrid v0: a project-owned dense monochrome carrier with direct pixel sampling and Fountain retained above it. The >=100 KB/s target remains unclaimed.

pullRequest.title: TF-004: OptiGrid dense monochrome carrier spike

currentFocus.title: TF-004 · Calibrate OptiGrid v0
currentFocus.detail: Implement and physically measure a direct-sampled monochrome matrix at 64/80/96/120/160 cells while keeping 60 Hz physical display and 24 Hz optical update fixed.

currentFocus.title: Select one dense carrier configuration from evidence
currentFocus.detail: Choose matrix density by unique optical payload ingress, CRC/alignment reject rate and receiver CPU timing; do not select by theoretical capacity alone.

currentFocus.title: Retain Fountain above the carrier
currentFocus.detail: After carrier calibration, integrate the selected OptiGrid frame format with the already proven rateless recovery layer and require a 1 MiB SHA-256 PASS.
